_help: A-36 world places (scripts/WorldSites.cs), Elden Ring style things to find off the roads. counts: how many of each kind per land ('default' for lands not listed). Placement is from terrain, roads and distances only (the same on every machine and the online server; seeds from the land, kind and try number): never in towns, on roads, in water or on steep ground (margins like data/wayside.json). Each kind: name, radius (flat ground needed, metres), slope (allowed height change across it), gap (metres from other sites), foes [lo, hi] and foeLevel (levels over the area). foes: monster types per land and kind. lore: message lines per kind (and per land in landLore). wayside: breakable props laid at the F-33 roadside sites, [type, local x, local z] in the site's frame (front +Z), y = floor (crypt: the chamber floor).

chapel: The bell fell long before the roof. They say it still rings on nights when no one listens.
Here the faithful asked the Light to stay. It did not answer, and in time neither did they.
Carved under the altar: WHAT IS GIVEN IN LIGHT IS TAKEN IN SHADOW.
The last priest sealed the doors from inside. The doors are gone now. The priest is not.
graveyard: No names on these stones. Only the dates, and the dates do not agree with each other.
Rest lightly, for the ground here is thin, and the Shadow is close beneath it.
A mourner's note, weathered: I buried you deep. Why do I hear you at the gate?
Those who dig here for gold find it. Those who dig for answers find company.
statue: A hero of a war no one remembers, holding a sword no one could lift.
The plaque is worn away but for one word: BETRAYED.
Pilgrims once left coins at its feet. Now only moss, and the coins of the moss.
They raised it to watch the road. It watches still, though the road has moved.
stones: The stones were here before the realms were split. They remember both.
Stand in the circle at dusk and you can hear the other world breathing.
Count the stones twice. If the number changes, leave.
Old blood on old rock. Whatever was asked of these stones, it was paid for.
giant: It fell when the sky broke. Nothing has grown taller since.
Even in death it points to the mountains, as if to warn of what came after.
A blade for a hand larger than a house. The smiths of that age are gone, and so is the hand.
The crows will not land on these bones. Neither should you.
lorestone: Beware: an ambush ahead. Or a friend. Hard to tell from here.
Visions of treasure... behind the waterfall? No. Behind you.
The Shadow realm keeps what the Light forgets. Shift, and look again.
Rest at the obelisks. The dead do not rest anywhere else.
If only I had a shield...
Praise the dawn, for night is long in these lands.
Barrels hold more than ale. Crates hold more than straw. Some boxes hold teeth.
Here lies one who opened every chest. Be wary of the hungry ones.
The road is safer. The road has nothing worth finding.
Seek the high places. The land shows its secrets to those who climb.
vista: From here the whole land lies open, roads like threads and towns like embers.
Wind, and distance, and the slow turning of the world. Breathe.
Somewhere out there is everything you are looking for. Somewhere.
corpse: A traveller who rested here, and never rose.

home: Oakhaven was built on an older town. The cellars go deeper than the houses ever did.
The Whispering Stones were singing before the first oak was planted.
frost: In Frostspire the snow keeps the dead fresh, and the dead keep the snow.
The yeti were men once. That is the story, and the yeti do not deny it.
sun: The Sunscar was a sea. The fish became sand. The sand remembers swimming.
Under Atheru's tombs sleep kings who paid in water for their crowns.
mire: Mirefen swallows roads, carts, and the people who come looking for both.
The marsh lights are not lanterns. Do not follow them home.
ember: Emberwild burns every autumn and grows back angrier.
Cinderhold's smiths quench their blades in the blood of the hill. The hill bleeds willingly.
elder: The Elderwood trees are older than the realms. They chose sides.
Aurelion's founders asked the forest for leave. The forest is still deciding.
